task1: A WSI of BRAF wildtype Colorectal Cancer at low resolution with visually descriptive characteristics of well-formed tubular and complex glandular architectures, infiltrative tumor margins extending into adjacent tissue, and a prominent desmoplastic stroma containing areas of luminal necrotic debris.
task2: A WSI of RAS wildtype Colorectal Cancer at low resolution with visually descriptive characteristics of moderately differentiated tubular structures, irregular infiltrative growth patterns into the surrounding stroma, and a variable fibroblastic desmoplastic reaction without extensive glandular crowding.
task3: A WSI of MMR wildtype Colorectal Cancer at low resolution with visually descriptive characteristics of classical tubular adenocarcinoma patterns, complex invading glandular structures, widespread luminal dirty necrosis, and an absence of significant peritumoral lymphoid aggregates or follicles.

task1: A WSI of BRAF mutant Colorectal Cancer at low resolution with visually descriptive characteristics of prominent mucinous differentiation characterized by large extracellular mucin pools, serrated or distorted glandular growth patterns, and frequent expansile or pushing tumor margins.
task2: A WSI of RAS mutant Colorectal Cancer at low resolution with visually descriptive characteristics of dense, irregularly shaped, and crowded glandular regions, complex cribriform architectural patterns, and notable intraluminal dirty necrosis surrounded by an active desmoplastic stroma.
task3: A WSI of MMR deficient Colorectal Cancer at low resolution with visually descriptive characteristics of solid or medullary tumor growth patterns lacking well-defined glands, distinct pushing tumor margins, and a dense peritumoral Crohn's-like lymphoid reaction featuring conspicuous lymphoid follicles.

task1: A WSI of BRAF wildtype Colorectal Cancer at high resolution with visually descriptive characteristics of pseudostratified columnar tumor cells with elongated hyperchromatic nuclei, distinct cell borders, preserved partial cellular polarity, and prominent intraluminal granular necrotic debris (dirty necrosis).
task2: A WSI of RAS wildtype Colorectal Cancer at high resolution with visually descriptive characteristics of an atypical glandular lining with pseudostratified hyperchromatic nuclei, relatively preserved cellular polarity, distinct cellular margins, and scattered mitotic figures.
task3: A WSI of MMR wildtype Colorectal Cancer at high resolution with visually descriptive characteristics of densely packed malignant glands, pleomorphic tumor cells with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, frequent mitoses, and a notable lack of prominent intraepithelial lymphocytes.

task1: A WSI of BRAF mutant Colorectal Cancer at high resolution with visually descriptive characteristics of atypical epithelial cells floating in abundant extracellular mucin, vesicular nuclei with prominent nucleoli, loss of regular glandular architecture, and the focal presence of signet-ring cell morphology.
task2: A WSI of RAS mutant Colorectal Cancer at high resolution with visually descriptive characteristics of disorganized epithelial cells with loss of nuclear polarity, marked apical mucin depletion, enlarged pleomorphic nuclei, and complex cribriform micro-architectures lacking intervening stroma.
task3: A WSI of MMR deficient Colorectal Cancer at high resolution with visually descriptive characteristics of poorly differentiated tumor cells forming solid sheets, large vesicular nuclei with distinct nucleoli, and a conspicuously high density of intraepithelial tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes (TILs).
